title: L2-L2-gain bounds for quadratic output systems
summary: We derive an explicit bound for the L2-L2-gain of linear time-invariant systems whose output is a quadratic function of the state and the input. Such systems appear naturally in many areas, for example for port-Hamiltonian systems, optimal-control, and stochastic problems. In case the output is purely quadratic in the state, the bound equals the L2-norm of the bivariate transfer function evaluated along the anti-diagonal $\{(s,\,-s)\mid s\in i\mathbb R\}$ of the $i \mathbb R\times i \mathbb R$ frequency domain.
